item.text: The cache library already supports deleting expired entries, but the wrapper never calls it, and the library’s `Keys()` includes expired keys. I’ll add an atomic eviction deadline for routine cleanup and make collection reads purge expired entries before returning results.

item.text: The first cache test run passes, including the 10 ms expiry cases. I found one more detail in the cache library: its `Items()` method changes eviction order while reading. I’m switching collection reads to its iterator so listing keys or values won’t affect which item is evicted at capacity.
